entities.title: Rule bundles
entities.summary: demo-zones.json: zone transitions for America/New_York, Europe/Paris and Atlantic/Reykjavik, for 2026 and 2027 only.
entities.purpose: Gives the fixtures and the example tests pinned, explicit zone rules, so no test depends on the host's tz database.
boundaries: Demonstration data, not a tz database release: real applications load a pinned tzdb release instead.
